subject.title: fix(clawhub): cap archive and clawpack download size at 256 MiB

question: Should OpenClaw make 256 MiB the hard ClawHub archive and ClawPack download cap for plugin and skill installs now?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and matches the marketplace cap, but the product/compatibility choice is whether any legitimate ClawHub package above that size should keep installing.

options.title: Accept the 256 MiB cap
options.body: Merge with the hard cap and treat larger ClawHub artifacts as unsupported until a real need for a different policy appears.

options.title: Request a different cap policy
options.body: Ask for a different limit or registry/manifest-backed policy before merge if maintainers expect valid ClawHub artifacts above 256 MiB.

options.title: Pause for live inventory proof
options.body: Hold the PR until someone checks current ClawHub package sizes and confirms no important published artifact exceeds the cap.

recommendation.title: Accept the 256 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Merge with the hard cap and treat larger ClawHub artifacts as unsupported until a real need for a different policy appears.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent history on the ClawHub helper itself and is the best routing candidate for the cap-policy decision among the inspected owners.
